 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Repeat non-background marks across equal-sized regions separated by a full line."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find full horizontal or vertical separator lines; their color is the
    # separator, and the most common other color is the field background.
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]

    if horizontal:
        sep = horizontal[0]
        # Repeating unit is the distance between matching separator rows,
        # or the first separator's position plus one when there is only one.
        period = (horizontal[1] - horizontal[0]) if len(horizontal) > 1 else sep + 1
        bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
        dividers = set(horizontal)
        # For each within-period coordinate, copy any observed mark to all
        # corresponding rows, preserving separator rows and existing marks.
        for r in range(h):
            if r in dividers:
                continue
            for c in range(w):
                vals = [grid[rr][c] for rr in range(h) if rr % period == r % period and rr not in dividers and grid[rr][c] != bg]
                if vals and grid[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = vals[0]
        return out

    if vertical:
        sep = vertical[0]
        period = (vertical[1] - vertical[0]) if len(vertical) > 1 else sep + 1
        bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
        dividers = set(vertical)
        for c in range(w):
            if c in dividers:
                continue
            for r in range(h):
                vals = [grid[r][cc] for cc in range(w) if cc % period == c % period and cc not in dividers and grid[r][cc] != bg]
                if vals and grid[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = vals[0]
        return out
    return out
"
}
